units.source_text: 驹子拖着艺妓那长长的衣服下摆，在被水冲过的瓦砾堆上，踉踉跄跄地走过去，把叶子抱回来。

en.t: Komako dragged the long hem of her geisha kimono, stumbled across the water-washed rubble, and carried Yoko back in her arms.

units.source_text: 叶子露出拼命挣扎的神情，耷拉着她那临终时呆滞的脸。

en.t: Yoko wore the look of someone struggling desperately, her vacant, dying face hanging slack.

units.source_text: 驹子仿佛抱着自己的牺牲和罪孽一样。

en.t: Komako seemed to be holding her own sacrifice and guilt in her arms.
